title: Business Requirements Document — Requirements Chat 11

sections.title: 1. Executive Summary & Strategic Rationale
sections.body: This Business Requirements Document (BRD) outlines the strategic rationale and business objectives for the development of a comprehensive Human Resources Management System (HRMS). The system is designed as a full-stack web and mobile application to centralize and automate core HR operations, including employee lifecycle management, payroll, recruitment, and performance tracking. By implementing a robust, API-driven architecture with role-based access control (RBAC), the organization aims to enhance operational efficiency, ensure data privacy, and provide a seamless self-service experience for all stakeholders. The system will support a complete end-to-end workflow from recruitment through to offboarding, ensuring compliance with industry standards and providing actionable analytics for strategic decision-making.

sections.title: 2. Business Objectives & Success Metrics
sections.body:
The primary business objectives for the HRMS include:
1. **Operational Efficiency:** Automate manual HR processes such as onboarding, leave management, and payroll processing to reduce administrative overhead.
2. **Data Integrity & Security:** Ensure secure handling of sensitive employee data through encryption, MFA-ready architecture, and strict RBAC.
3. **Employee Experience:** Provide a modern, responsive UI for web, Android, and iOS to facilitate employee and manager self-service.
4. **Strategic Insights:** Deliver comprehensive dashboards and reports for HR analytics, including headcount, attrition, and performance metrics.

Success Metrics:
- Reduction in manual processing time for payroll and onboarding.
- 100% audit trail coverage for all critical data modifications.
- High user adoption rate across all defined roles (Super Admin, HR, Manager, etc.).
- System uptime and reliability meeting production-ready standards.

sections.title: 3. Scope & Operational Boundaries (In/Out of Scope)
sections.body:
**In Scope:**
- **Core HR:** Employee master data, departments, designations, branches, onboarding/offboarding, and profiles.
- **Time & Attendance:** Shift/roster management, leave/holiday management, work-from-home requests, and timesheets.
- **Payroll & Finance:** Salary structures, deductions, bonuses, reimbursements, payslips, and tax/statutory information.
- **Recruitment:** Applicant tracking, job postings, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, and joining management.
- **Performance & Development:** Goals/KPIs, appraisals, feedback, and training/learning modules.
- **Administration:** Asset management, grievances, announcements, notifications, policies, and HR letters.
- **Technical Infrastructure:** Centralized backend API, relational database, file storage, notification services, background jobs, and security features (RBAC, JWT, MFA).
- **Workflows:** Configurable approval chains for HR, managers, finance, and admins.

**Out of Scope:**
- Integration with external third-party accounting software (unless specified via API in future phases).
- Physical hardware procurement for mobile devices.
- Legal compliance consulting services (system supports compliance features but does not provide legal advice).

sections.title: 4. Key Stakeholders & Governance Personas
sections.body:
The system is designed to serve the following key stakeholders and governance personas:
- **Super Admin:** Full system configuration, user management, and master data control.
- **HR/Admin:** Manage employee lifecycle, recruitment, performance, and HR policies.
- **Manager:** Approve leave/attendance, manage team performance, and oversee departmental operations.
- **Recruiter:** Manage candidate pipelines, interviews, and job postings.
- **Employee:** Self-service portal for leave requests, profile updates, payslips, and training.
- **Finance/Payroll:** Process payroll, manage deductions/bonuses, and handle statutory compliance.

Governance is maintained through configurable approval workflows and role-based permission management to ensure segregation of duties and data privacy.

sections.title: 5. Business Requirements Specification Matrix
table: Implement JWT/session management, MFA-ready architecture, and role-based access control for all user types.
Users can only access modules permitted by their role; MFA is optional but architecturally supported.

Complete workflow from joining to exit is tracked with audit logs.

Manage job postings, candidate pipelines, interviews, offers, and joining management.

Leave balances are updated in real-time and approvals follow configured workflows.

Notifications are triggered based on workflow events and user preferences.

Application is functional and responsive across all supported platforms.

sections.title: 6. Assumptions & Operational Constraints
sections.body:
**Assumptions:**
- The organization has a stable internet connection for cloud-based access.
- Users have compatible devices (smartphones/tablets) for mobile app access.
- Master data (departments, designations) is maintained by the Super Admin.

**Operational Constraints:**
- The system must be production-ready, scalable, and API-driven.
- Data privacy and security are paramount, requiring encryption and secure document access.
- The system must support bulk import/export via Excel/CSV and PDF generation for reports.
- Configurable workflows must allow for flexible approval chains without code changes.

sections.title: 7. Risk & Compliance Baseline
sections.body:
While the source document does not explicitly cite specific banking compliance frameworks, the system's handling of sensitive employee data and financial payroll information necessitates adherence to industry-standard security and compliance benchmarks. 

**Compliance & Security Baseline:**
- **Data Privacy:** Strict adherence to data privacy regulations, ensuring secure storage and transmission of employee PII.
- **Audit Immutability:** All audit logs must be immutable to ensure traceability and accountability, aligning with SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) principles for financial integrity.
- **Access Control:** RBAC and MFA-ready architecture mitigate risks of unauthorized access, supporting ISO 27001 security controls.
- **Transaction Integrity:** Payroll and financial modules must ensure transaction atomicity to prevent data corruption, a critical NFR benchmark for financial systems.
- **Uptime:** The system must meet high availability standards (e.g., 99.99% uptime) to ensure continuous access to critical HR and payroll functions.

**Risk Mitigation:**
- Regular backups and disaster recovery plans.
- Continuous monitoring and logging for anomaly detection.
- Regular security audits and penetration testing.

File: HR Management System.pdf

HR Management System 
 
Build a complete HR Management System (HRMS) as a full-stack web and mobile 
application with role-based access for Super Admin, HR/Admin, Manager, Recruiter, 
Employee, and Finance/Payroll users. The system should include **secure authentication, 
role and permission management, employee master data, departments, designations, branches, 
employee onboarding/offboarding, employee profiles, document management, attendance, 
shift and roster management, leave and holiday management, work-from-home/remote-work 
requests, regularization, timesheets, payroll, salary structures, deductions, bonuses, 
reimbursements, payslips, tax/statutory information, recruitment and applicant tracking, job 
postings, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, joining management, performance 
management, goals/KPIs, appraisals, feedback, training and learning, asset management, 
employee grievances, announcements, notifications, company policies, HR letters/certificates, 
expense management, travel requests, approval workflows, surveys, employee self-service, 
manager self-service, and comprehensive dashboards and reports. Include search, filters, 
sorting, pagination, bulk import/export, Excel/CSV upload, PDF generation, audit logs, 
activity history, configurable workflows, email/SMS/push notifications, reminders, 
calendar integration, and API integrations. The dashboard should provide HR analytics 
such as headcount, attendance, leave utilization, attrition, recruitment status, payroll 
summaries, department statistics, performance, pending approvals, and upcoming events. 
The project should have a modern responsive UI for Web, Android, and iOS, with a 
centralized backend API, relational database, file/document storage, notification service, 
background jobs, logging, monitoring, validation, encryption, backups, and strong security 
including RBAC, JWT/session management, password policies, MFA-ready architecture, 
API authorization, data privacy, audit trails, and secure document access. Define 
complete workflows such as Recruitment → Candidate Selection → Offer → Joining → 
Onboarding → Employee → Attendance/Leave → Payroll → Performance → 
Promotion/Transfer → Offboarding/Exit, with configurable approval chains for HR, 
managers, finance, and admins. Include master-data configuration, organization settings, 
financial/payroll settings, notification templates, workflow configuration, reports, audit logs, 
and system administration. The final system should be production-ready, scalable, API-
driven, well-documented, tested, and include BRD, SRS, database schema/ERD, API 
documentation, RTM, UI/UX specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, test 
cases, deployment documentation, and complete role-wise functional requirements.
